fields.description: Wasel brings apartments and a separate penthouse collection to Dubai Islands. Its planned leisure spaces include pools, a cinema, a clubhouse and children’s play areas. Early drawings and later portal material describe different release details, so the specific unit’s current plan matters more than a single headline size.

research.locationNote: Dubai Islands, Dubai. Community beach, marina and yacht-club plans are not promised as private facilities attached to every residence.
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s AED 1.7 m is an attributed launch guide. Earlier brochures and listings advertise lower launch figures; no current developer price list or unit availability was verified.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder publishes 10/40/50 and 20/30/50 alternatives, each totalling 100%. The displayed 10/40/50 is one portal option, not a universal current contract. No primary dated payment calendar was retrieved.
research.handoverNote: An early shareable deck targets June 2027; Property Finder’s current entry forecasts February 2028. Other broker feeds differ further. The headline date is withheld until the unit-specific contract is confirmed.

unresolved: The early deck labels 221 homes and marks its 3/4-bedroom penthouses work in progress. Final penthouse areas, bedroom allocation and private pools need the approved plan; no unit count is treated as current inventory.

Early penthouse drawings explicitly expect design changes. The 6-page pack is a floor-plate study, not a full unit-area schedule; selected unit sizes above are attributed portal entries. A deck tax footnote is not adopted as a blanket residential tax rule.
